# QnALog 1.6.10

## Highlights

- Note context menu: **Reorganize** regenerates the note body in place with your default organizing mode, without creating a derived note. The previous body is kept as a recoverable version and appears as a **Before reorganization** row under the note. The **Original** row then shows the reorganized body. Notes whose cached version data cannot be read are left unchanged, and nothing is written if you edit the note while the model is running.
- The former "Reorganize as" is now **Generate derived version**, and the **Generate** submenu (email draft, HTML and PDF reports) is now **Export**.
- The note menu also has **Open outline** and **Distill content**, which jump to the matching sidebar tab for that note; Distill starts a scan only if the note has not been scanned yet.
- The sidebar opens on **Notes**, and the tabs are ordered Notes, Outline, Distill, Q&A, Topics.
- A transcription glossary button next to the board and settings buttons opens the glossary file, creating it if needed, and switches to the existing tab instead of opening a new one each time.
- The progress window and status bar no longer say "Processing complete" while the title and note index are still being generated; new "Generating title" and "Updating note index" stages are shown first.
- Organized notes no longer contain segment references such as "(SEG 1–2)".

## User impact

The settings schema and API key storage are unchanged. No notes are rewritten unless you use Reorganize. Reorganize keeps the file name, so the title in the note can differ from the file name. The note frontmatter gains `qnalog_pre_reorganize_version` after a reorganization; it points to the recoverable version and can be left as is.
